title: tk factory setup credential walkthrough
description: The BotFather-style first-run walk (deployment model section): checks wrangler auth, offers tk factory deploy if no deployment exists, walks the GitHub credential ladder (fine-grained repo-scoped PAT first; personal GitHub App documented as the upgrade path) and stores the choice as Worker secrets, configures the AI Gateway base URL and provider keys (Workers AI needs no key — same account), and verifies each rung with a live probe (a gateway model list call, a GitHub API call with the PAT) before moving on. Mirrors the tone and structure of tk channel setup telegram: one rung at a time, verify, then persist; secrets go to Worker secrets or ~/.ticksrc (0600), never the repo.
acceptance_criteria: A user with a Cloudflare account, a repo, and a PAT reaches a fully configured factory through prompts alone, with each credential verified live before it is stored. tk factory status reports what is configured and whether each credential currently works, offline-safe with a flag, following the tk channel status pattern. No secret ever lands in a tracked file, enforced by a test on the persistence paths.
